title: Britain (UK)
subtitle: University stonework and festival streets in Scotland, followed by London’s parks, galleries, river walks and evening lights.
category: A journey through Scotland and England

paragraphs: The Thames brings the familiar outlines of the clock tower, Parliament and the London Eye into view. The walk crosses the bridge and continues to the carved entrance of the Abbey.

paragraphs: The walk crosses Tower Bridge and follows the river past stone embankments and bridges. At the Globe, wooden galleries circle the open sky and a decorated stage; outside, St Paul’s catches the last light.
